name: Viral Recreate Ai
original_description: Viral Recreate AI analyses uploaded images and videos and turns them into structured generation prompts. It can break videos down scene by scene with timestamps, shot descriptions, camera angles, framing, camera movement, subject and object movement, lighting, visual style and sound. It provides separate image-generation, video-generation, movement + sound, complete image and complete video prompts. It can also create image-to-video animation plans from still images.
